title: activeCallId lifecycle: not auto-cleared when VTCCall ends
description: SceneRegion.activeCallId is client-patchable (line 930) and never automatically cleared when the referenced VTCCall transitions to 'ended' state. The region permanently points at a dead call. No StateChange or Scene WSS event notifies Scene subscribers that the bound call ended. Implementers must decide: (a) server auto-clears on call end, (b) left stale until region owner patches, or (c) server rejects ended call ids. Spec is silent. Related: VTCCall ends (vtc-00.md lines 889-890) but Scene side has no corresponding automation (scene-00.md line 288).
